info.name: Calendar Audit Log
info.summary: Writes a structured audit log entry for every calendar event create, update, and delete.
info.description: Listens to CalendarObjectCreatedEvent, CalendarObjectUpdatedEvent, and CalendarObjectDeletedEvent and writes a row to the oc_calendar_audit table containing the actor, operation, calendar name, and parsed iCal fields (UID, SUMMARY, DTSTART, RECURRENCE-ID).
info.author: Arnout Engelen
